messages.subject: =?UTF-8?Q?Introduction_=E2=80=93_GSoC_2026_Aspirant?=
messages.body:
Hi everyone,

I’m Rishit Ghosh, a 2nd year undergraduate specializing in CSE (AI/ML).

I’m preparing for GSoC 2026 and am interested in contributing to Apache
Airflow.
I have foundational experience in Python, DBMS, and backend systems, and
I’m eager to learn and contribute to the project.


Looking forward to engaging with the community and contributing
meaningfully.

GitHub: https://github.com/rajghosh06-dev
Portfolio: https://rajghosh06-dev.github.io/portfolio/index.html

Thanks and regards,
Rishit

messages.subject: =?UTF-8?Q?Re=3A_Introduction_=E2=80=93_GSoC_2026_Aspirant?=
messages.body:
Hi Rishit,

welcome!

No need to announce on devlist but contributions are always welcome!

To get started if not found already please take a look to our 
"Contributors Quick Start" 
in https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/contributing-docs/03_contributors_quick_start.rst 
and if you seek for some issue to start with, we maintain a list of 
issues with a label "good first issue" which might be suitable for 
starting a 
contribution: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22good%20first%20issue%22

In any question where you need support, feel free to consult in our 
#new-contributors channel in Slack, see 
https://airflow.apache.org/community/ how to join.

And as well if not done already, feel free to join the devlist as well 
which is the official form of discussions for developments.

Jens

messages.body:
Welcome to the Airflow Community, Rishit.

In addition to Jen's suggestions, you can also watch this video from Jason:
https://airflowsummit.org/sessions/2025/becoming-an-apache-airflow-committer-from-0/
at the Airflow Summit 2025, which will provide some tips on how best to get
started.

Thanks & Regards,
Amogh Desai

messages.body:
Welcome, Rishit! One tip - when picking a good first issue, try to find one
that touches an area you're curious about (scheduler, UI, providers, etc.).
It makes the learning process more enjoyable. Good luck!

Regards,
Rahul
